positioning: Tool stack for paid ads, live room operations, video editing, AI video, and real-shot plus AI mixed ecommerce creative.
rules: External tools are used to save time, not to bypass platform rules.
AI can generate briefs, prompts, storyboards, editing checklists, and action queues.
Publishing, ad budget changes, live product links, discounts, coupons, uploads, and creator outreach require human confirmation.
All AI videos must pass IP, celebrity likeness, brand, music, claim, and platform policy checks before use.

tools.name: Seedance 2.0
workflow: Start from real product proof shot or reference image.
Generate only supporting shots that do not replace truthful product evidence.
Keep product, logo, package, color, and material consistent.
Mix with real-shot closeups, subtitle hook, product-card CTA, and end card.
Run compliance/IP review before publish or creator delivery.
guardrails: Do not imitate a celebrity, influencer, competitor model, copyrighted character, or brand-owned scene.
Do not generate false product effects, fake before/after, medical claims, or unrealistic performance proof.
Do not use unauthorized music, logos, trademarks, or copyrighted footage.

tools.name: Real-shot mobile product footage
workflow: Use AI video only to add missing scenes, transitions, or lifestyle support.

tools.name: Video editing stack
workflow: Keep product proof before lifestyle support.
End with CTA and product-card timing.
